Description

Are you worried about Vitamin B12 deficiency? In this informative video, Aruna Devi explains the importance of Vitamin B12, common food sources, and healthy dietary habits that may help support normal B12 levels.

Vitamin B12 plays an important role in red blood cell formation, nerve function, energy metabolism, and overall health. This video also discusses leafy vegetables, nutrition, and practical food habits for people looking to improve their diet.

Watch the full video to know more about:

• Vitamin B12 food sources
• Common signs of B12 deficiency
• Foods that support nerve health
• Healthy diet tips
• Vegetarian diet considerations
• When B12 testing or supplementation may be needed

If you suspect Vitamin B12 deficiency, consult a qualified healthcare professional and consider appropriate testing. Do not rely on a single food or home remedy to treat a confirmed deficiency.
